A small follow-up to 0.2.0 for anyone whose galleryLAB stopped opening.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account, over an existing copy in the same
  folder. Your Library and settings are kept.
- **galleryLAB-portable.exe** runs without installing.

Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Windows SmartScreen may say the build isn't recognised; choose **More
info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's changed

- **If galleryLAB can't start, it now says why** instead of closing silently, and writes each startup step to
  `%APPDATA%\galleryLAB\logs\startup.log`. If a copy of galleryLAB is already running in the background, the
  new one hands over to it; the log records that too.
- The release checks now import a real photo through the packaged app before publishing.

If galleryLAB shows a spinner and then nothing, open Task Manager, end any galleryLAB entries, and start it
again. If it still won't open, send the last lines of `startup.log`.
